parts.name: Fan
parts.Basic_description: This is the fan blade assembly of an axial cooling fan, made of ABS plastic. It consists of multiple blades attached to a central hub.
parts.Functional_description: The fan blades rotate to generate airflow, cooling electronic components or ventilating air through a system.
parts.Movement_description: This part rotates around its central axis when powered by the motor, converting electrical energy into mechanical airflow.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or frame of the axial cooling fan, made of ABS plastic. It provides structural support for the fan blades and motor.
parts.Functional_description: The base body holds the fan assembly in place, ensuring stability and proper alignment during operation. It also allows for mounting onto other surfaces or devices.
parts.Movement_description: This part remains stationary during operation, serving as the fixed housing for the rotating fan blades.
